what: Chewy sells pet food, medicine and supplies online, with most revenue on automatic repeat delivery, and it has been adding veterinary clinics and a pet insurance offer.
customers: American pet owners, mostly on subscription autoship for food and medication.
money: pet food and treats, mostly on autoship
prescription medication, vet clinics and insurance
moat: Autoship: about four-fifths of sales repeat automatically, which turns a retailer into something closer to a subscription business and makes the customer relationship durable.
risks: A 1.8% net margin: online pet retail is a volume business
Pet adoption rates fell after the pandemic surge, which slows new customer growth
Amazon competes directly on the same products
opportunities: 14.4 times free cash flow with $568M of free cash flow and $879M of cash
Revenue grew from $9.0B to $12.6B in four years
Analysts see about 39% upside, and pharmacy and vet clinics earn far better margins than food
watch: Net sales per active customer and the growth of the health and pharmacy business.
